name: Web and interactive content
shortDescription: Web and interactive content and medical device sales enablement for cardiology campaigns: microsites, interactive experiences and digital tools, plus AI-assisted production projects that get more from every shoot.
whyThisMatters:
Web and interactive content gives your audience something to explore: campaign microsites, interactive sales tools and 3D product experiences that physicians, reps and buyers can use for themselves.

A film tells a story once. An interactive tool lets a rep tailor the conversation to the physician in front of them, lets a buyer explore the evidence at their own pace, and keeps a campaign alive long after launch. In MedTech, where every conversation is different, that flexibility matters.

We build interactive content around the clinical story: microsites that are the long-term home for a campaign, and touchscreen sales tools with 3D cath lab scenes, product explorers with rotate, zoom and hotspots, procedure modules and evidence libraries, plus a presentation mode for the booth.
outcomesDescription: Tools your teams and your audience will use again and again.
outcomesFirstDescription: Reps choose the procedure, product and evidence that matter to the physician in front of them.
outcomesSecondDescription: Explore devices with 360° rotate, zoom and hotspots, in context in a 3D cath lab.
outcomesThirdDescription: Microsites that hold the films, the evidence and the calls to action for each audience.

faqs.question: What kinds of interactive content do you make?
faqs.answer: Campaign microsites, interactive sales tools for desktop and touchscreen, 3D product explorers, procedure modules and evidence libraries. For RCS, the Clean Those Leads microsite became the long-term home for the campaign's films, evidence and calls to action; for ORSIF, the is-not-here.com site commemorates healthcare workers affected by radiation.

faqs.question: What is an interactive sales tool?
faqs.answer: It is an app reps use with physicians and buyers, on a laptop, tablet or touchscreen. Ours can include a 3D cath lab scene, a product explorer with 360° rotate, zoom and hotspots, procedure-by-procedure modules, a clinical evidence library and a presentation mode for booths and large screens.

faqs.question: Can our team update the content?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can build in a content management system so your team can update products, procedures and evidence without a new build.

faqs.question: Do you use AI in production?
faqs.answer: Where it helps and where it is appropriate for medical content, we use AI-assisted tools to speed up production tasks, always with human review of anything clinical.
